hints.title: Algebraic Invariant Transformation
hints.text: The condition nums[i_j] - nums[i_k] >= i_j - i_k for i_j > i_k rearranges to nums[i_j] - i_j >= nums[i_k] - i_k.

hints.title: LIS with Value Accumulation
hints.text: Let key[i] = nums[i] - i. We need to find an increasing subsequence of keys that maximizes the sum of chosen nums values.

hints.title: Fenwick Tree over Coordinate Compression
hints.text: Coordinate compress unique key values. Maintain a Fenwick tree to query the maximum DP sum for all keys <= key[i].
